title: Carry praise, not counterfeit profit
summary: Lasting merchandise is praise that can travel beyond visible profit. Do not let appetite crowd out what remains.
takeaway: Do not let appetite crowd out what remains.
lifeApplication: Before the next purchase, deal, or status chase, ask what here can still travel with the soul when the room is empty.

source.shortMeaning: Lasting merchandise is praise that can travel beyond visible profit.
source.lifeApplication: At the point of purchase, ask whether this gain can travel with you.

evidence.coreClaim: Lasting merchandise is praise that can travel beyond visible profit.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: pause the deal and choose the profit that can follow you.
